prajna.name: Prajna Classics
prajna.description: A family of texts centered on emptiness wisdom, from the concise Heart Sutra to the vast Great Prajnaparamita collection.

texts.title: Heart Sutra
texts.description: The shortest and most distilled Prajnaparamita text, summarizing the heart of prajna thought in 260 Chinese characters.

texts.title: Diamond Sutra
texts.description: Uses the diamond as an image for prajna wisdom and became a major scriptural basis for Chan Buddhism.

texts.title: Large Prajnaparamita Sutra
texts.description: An important Prajnaparamita translation by Kumarajiva.

texts.title: Great Prajnaparamita Sutra
texts.description: Xuanzang's 600-fascicle collection, the most comprehensive Chinese Prajnaparamita corpus.

pureland.name: Pure Land Five Scriptures
pureland.description: Core Pure Land texts describing Sukhavati and the path of rebirth through Amitabha practice.

texts.title: Amitabha Sutra
texts.description: One of the Three Pure Land Sutras and the most widely recited Pure Land scripture.

texts.title: Infinite Life Sutra
texts.description: Presents Amitabha Buddha's Forty-eight Vows in detail.

texts.title: Contemplation Sutra
texts.description: Teaches the sixteen contemplations and the nine grades of rebirth.

texts.title: Dashizhi Bodhisattva's Perfect Penetration Through Buddha Recitation
texts.description: A concise teaching on Buddha-recitation practice from the Shurangama Sutra.

texts.title: Samantabhadra's Aspiration Chapter
texts.description: From the Avatamsaka Sutra, directing the ten great vows toward rebirth in Sukhavati.

lotus.name: Lotus Classics
lotus.description: Foundational Tiantai texts centered on revealing the real through the provisional and unifying the three vehicles.

texts.title: Lotus Sutra
texts.description: Kumarajiva's translation and the foundational scripture of Tiantai Buddhism.

texts.title: Zhengfa Hua Sutra
texts.description: Dharmaraksha's translation, the earliest Chinese translation of the Lotus Sutra.

texts.title: Sutra on the Practice of Contemplating Samantabhadra
texts.description: One of the three Lotus scriptures, focused on repentance and purification.

chan.name: Chan Texts
chan.description: Core scriptures, recorded sayings, lamp records, and koan collections for direct pointing and seeing one's nature.

texts.title: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch
texts.description: Teachings of Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of Chan, and the only Chinese Buddhist patriarchal work called a sutra.

texts.title: Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp
texts.description: A representative lamp-record text preserving Chan lineage accounts.

texts.title: Blue Cliff Record
texts.description: Yuanwu Keqin's annotated collection, often called the foremost Chan koan book.

texts.title: Compendium of the Five Lamps
texts.description: A comprehensive compilation of five lamp records and Chan encounter dialogues.

vinaya.name: Vinaya Selections
vinaya.description: Buddhist disciplinary texts on monastic life, communal order, and practice norms.

texts.title: Four-Part Vinaya
texts.description: Dharmaguptaka Vinaya, the most widely used vinaya tradition in Chinese Buddhism.

texts.title: Brahma Net Sutra
texts.description: A foundational Mahayana bodhisattva precepts text.

texts.title: Mahasamghika Vinaya
texts.description: The vinaya text of the Mahasamghika school.

agama.name: Agama / Nikaya
agama.description: Early scriptures shared across northern and southern traditions, preserving direct records of the Buddha's early teachings.

texts.title: Dirgha Agama
texts.description: A 22-fascicle collection corresponding to the Pali Digha Nikaya, including texts such as the Mahaparinirvana Sutra.

texts.title: Madhyama Agama
texts.description: A 60-fascicle collection corresponding to the Pali Majjhima Nikaya.

texts.title: Samyukta Agama
texts.description: A 50-fascicle collection corresponding to the Pali Samyutta Nikaya and close to early Buddhist teaching strata.

texts.title: Ekottarika Agama
texts.description: A 51-fascicle collection corresponding to the Pali Anguttara Nikaya.

yogacara.name: Yogacara Texts
yogacara.description: Core Yogacara scriptures and treatises analyzing the structure and transformation of consciousness.

texts.title: Samdhinirmocana Sutra
texts.description: A foundational Yogacara scripture and classic statement of the three-turnings teaching.

texts.title: Cheng Weishi Lun
texts.description: Xuanzang's synthetic translation and a defining work of East Asian Yogacara.

texts.title: Yogacarabhumi
texts.description: A 100-fascicle Yogacara encyclopedia attributed to Maitreya and transmitted by Asanga.

texts.title: Mahayanasamgraha
texts.description: Asanga's concise outline of Yogacara thought.

avatamsaka.name: Avatamsaka Classics
avatamsaka.description: Foundational Huayan texts presenting dharmadhatu dependent arising and the unobstructed interpenetration of all phenomena.

texts.title: Avatamsaka Sutra
texts.description: The 80-fascicle translation by Shikshananda and the central scripture of Huayan Buddhism.

texts.title: Avatamsaka Sutra (Sixty-Fascicle Version)
texts.description: The 60-fascicle translation by Buddhabhadra.
